The <b>{{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a mid-tier weapon, which inflicts {{Health|-|15}} of damage to enemies. It can either be crafted at an advanced [[Anvil II|anvil]], or purchased from either [[Koukol]] near the [[mountain fort]] or [[Krezvold]] the blacksmith. It's unique among weapons as being a required material for the crafting of higher-tiered weaponry.
